messages.content: You are handing a case over to the next analyst, who will make the decision. For every candidate claim, record whether the original records establish it (supported), establish its negation (contradicted), or do neither (unresolved). Attach exact source identifiers of decisive records, or an empty list if none settle it. Copy the preceding analyst's numeric estimates of claim truth as confidence values. Preserve unresolved status absent new independent evidence. Use the note to summarize the relevant record contents and preserve source identifiers for anything mentioned. Keep the note under 100 words.

{"scenario":"Northbrook treatment","question":"Should the operator close the review for filter train M2?","claims":{"A":"M2 passed the April pressure test.","B":"A bypass on M2 received a flow alarm at 09:10.","C":"M2 was serviced that morning."},"sources":{"S1":"control historian records a flow alarm on M2 bypass at 09:10.","S2":"shift sign-off says the site used filter train M1 all morning and no service was performed on M2.","S3":"maintenance chat says, 'M2 passed pressure from what I heard'. It has no instrument reading and was sent before the test team handed over results."},"prior_assessment":{"claims":{"A":{"status":"unresolved","citations":["S3"],"confidence":60},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S1"],"confidence":90},"C":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S2"],"confidence":90}},"note":"Claim A is provisionally supported by maintenance chat (S3) but lacks direct test data and was hearsay before official results, so status is unresolved with moderate confidence. Claim B is supported by control historian records (S1) showing a flow alarm on M2 bypass at 09:10, with high confidence. Claim C is contradicted by shift sign-off (S2) stating no service was performed on M2 that morning, with high confidence."}}
